title: Side bar: patient, branch and cash register
summary: Find a patient from any screen, change your working branch and view or open the cash register.

steps.title: Open the bar
steps.details: If it's closed, it's the little tab at the top right.

steps.title: Search
steps.details: Type a name, ID or phone and choose: their quick record opens with appointments, balance and actions. If they don't exist, you can register them from here.

steps.title: Choose the branch
steps.details: The calendar, the cash register and the lists are filtered by the chosen branch.

steps.title: Your cash register
steps.details: With an open cash register: its summary and access to the session. Without one: the button to open it. Without an open cash register you can't take cash.
